invariants.rule: Project Control, Codex, telemetry, remote control, and host-specific semantics stay behind application or provider boundaries.
Core desktop abstractions remain independent of any specific machine, SSH topology, control backend, or deployment profile.
Do not stabilize a plugin ABI until multiple working applications provide evidence for the required extension boundary.
Python 3.12 or newer is the default implementation substrate; native extensions require a demonstrated low-level or performance need.
An embedded interactive pane requires a mature VT terminal-state engine; a PTY alone is not an embedded terminal and txtDesk does not invent a fake emulator.
Terminal initialization has explicit ownership and restoration on normal and handled-error exits; terminal corruption is a serious defect.
Use Textual as the current TUI foundation and do not build a redundant widget, layout, focus, or event framework underneath it.

tasks.objective: Deliver a portable host-agnostic text-mode desktop through restrained milestones.
tasks.title: txtDesk portable terminal desktop

tasks.notes: Completed by the bounded bootstrap and corrective Python-foundation pass. The console entry point remains a placeholder and no M1 desktop behavior is implemented.
tasks.objective: Establish identity, documentation, agent guidance, a Python package skeleton, authoritative workflow, and Project Control visibility without implementing the desktop.
tasks.title: Repository foundation

tasks.objective: Validate package entry points, Textual startup, resize, shutdown, failure cleanup, graceful degradation, representative TERM configurations, and SSH-like sessions.
tasks.title: Textual shell and terminal compatibility validation

tasks.objective: Add basic keyboard dispatch and global commands without coupling input events to application-specific semantics.
tasks.title: Input and command handling

tasks.next_action: Implement the smallest Textual-based desktop composition; do not add embedded terminal panes or a framework beneath Textual.
tasks.objective: Build the smallest real txtDesk composition above Textual with clean startup and exit, resize behavior, minimal chrome, global commands, and one simple surface.
tasks.title: Minimal Textual application shell

tasks.objective: Establish txtDesk desktop chrome and surface registration using Textual primitives, with no stable plugin API or speculative base-class hierarchy.
tasks.title: Desktop surface and application model

tasks.objective: Build small filesystem, process, and status surfaces that exercise composition without embedding host-specific collection policy in the core.
tasks.title: Basic filesystem, process, and status applications

tasks.objective: Add portable configuration and keybinding behavior based on actual desktop command needs.
tasks.title: Configuration and keybindings

tasks.objective: Provide a coherent launcher or command palette for built-in applications and desktop commands.
tasks.title: Command palette and application launcher

tasks.objective: Develop evidence-backed split, tab, placement, and focus traversal behavior for multiple surfaces.
tasks.title: Layout and focus composition

tasks.objective: Evaluate and integrate a mature Python-accessible terminal-state engine or contained native binding with PTY lifecycle, screen buffers, rendering, input forwarding, resize propagation, and interactive shells.
tasks.title: Embedded terminal application and VT engine integration

tasks.objective: Add Codex interaction as an application/provider using demonstrated integration boundaries rather than core semantics.
tasks.title: Codex application/provider

tasks.objective: Expose Project Control through an application and provider without transferring Project Control semantics into the desktop core.
tasks.title: Project Control application/provider

tasks.objective: Present GPU, CPU, network, and storage telemetry through replaceable providers without making txtDesk a monitoring library.
tasks.title: Telemetry applications/providers

tasks.objective: Build optional edge applications and profiles for the iMac, server power, IPMI, IoT mains, Tailscale-aware management, and other deployment-specific needs.
tasks.title: Host-specific deployment and control applications

tasks.objective: Validate unit tests, packaging and entry points, TUI smoke behavior, SSH and terminal compatibility, architecture boundaries, and user/developer documentation across the delivered project.
tasks.title: Cross-milestone validation, testing, and documentation
